name: Contacts
description: CRM records: contacts, organizations, interactions, and tags, owner-scoped with project sharing and global search. Seeds one 59 detail view + site_routes row per collection (/contacts/{id}, /organizations/{id}, /interactions/{id}, /tags/{id}), each routed through app-views' site_view_render -- a soft reference like template_id's, not a hard dependency: without app-views installed the routes simply 404, the same graceful degrade site routing already has for any unresolved path. 0.2.0 deletes the bespoke /contacts list page object: it was ~80 lines of chrome around two generator calls with no business logic of its own, and is now a seeded VIEW record over the same `list` block /notes uses (title_field: full_name, the formula field already computed server-side). Contacts declare capabilities.attachments (a signed contract, an ID) and deliberately NOT comments: `interactions` already records what was said to this person, and a second thread beside it would split that history in half.
